headline.zh: 为细胞信号通路图绘制视觉方案
headline.en: Design a visual plan for cell signaling pathway

scenario.zh: 你正在撰写关于MAPK通路的综述论文,需要一张清晰的示意图展示信号级联反应过程
scenario.en: You're writing a review on MAPK pathway and need a clear diagram showing the signal cascade

instruction.zh: 确定你想强调通路的哪个方面
instruction.en: Decide which aspect of the pathway to emphasize

output.zh: 工作区更新为多层级联结构,Leo建议使用蛋白质复合物图标
output.en: Workspace shows multi-tier cascade; Leo suggests protein complex icons

output.zh: 工作区调整为对比布局,Leo推荐标注突变位点的模板
output.en: Workspace shifts to comparison layout; Leo recommends mutation-marker template

instruction.zh: 从图标库选择符合学术标准的组件
instruction.en: Select academically vetted components from icon library

output.zh: 已加载RTK、RAF、MEK、ERK标准图标,所有元素可单独编辑
output.en: Loaded RTK, RAF, MEK, ERK standard icons; all elements individually editable

output.zh: 已加载细胞膜、细胞质、核膜剖面图,便于展示空间定位
output.en: Loaded membrane, cytoplasm, nuclear envelope sections for spatial context

instruction.zh: Leo生成了两种符合期刊要求的排版

output.zh: 信号从上至下展开,适合单栏排版,箭头清晰标注磷酸化步骤
output.en: Signal flows top-down; fits single-column format with phosphorylation steps labeled

output.zh: 强调ERK对上游的负反馈,适合机制讨论,突出调控节点
output.en: Emphasizes ERK negative feedback; suits mechanism discussion with regulation nodes highlighted

instruction.zh: 确认图示符合目标期刊的图形规范
instruction.en: Confirm diagram meets target journal graphics standards

output.zh: 草案已就绪,包含所有图层和标注,可在BioRender中继续调整细节
output.en: Draft ready with all layers and labels; further refinement available in BioRender

label.zh: 导出审稿用高分辨率版本

output.zh: 已准备符合期刊要求的TIFF格式草案,图例和比例尺已按规范配置
output.en: Prepared journal-standard TIFF draft; legend and scale bar configured per guidelines

takeaway.zh: Leo将科学图标库、布局模板和期刊规范整合,帮你快速构建准确的学术图示草案
takeaway.en: Leo integrates vetted icon libraries, layout templates and journal standards to rapidly build accurate academic diagram drafts
